lessons.text: Don't give a new hire like Kofi the full moderate, heavy, very heavy run alone. Mix his shop repair work with lighter tasks or pair him with an experienced worker.
Marcus heats up faster than forecast on moderate and heavy work from 10:00, even though he is acclimatized. Give him jobs like transformer maintenance before 10:00.
